purpose: Tracks places where families can be made to feel that they personally caused, prevented, or failed a death because institutional language was poorly carried.

pressure_patterns.name: Love equals more intervention
pressure_patterns.safer_counterframe: Ask what the person would count as benefit, burden, dignity, comfort, or unacceptable suffering.

pressure_patterns.name: Comfort equals abandonment
pressure_patterns.safer_counterframe: Name what care continues: presence, symptom attention, touch, explanation, ritual, privacy, and responsiveness.

pressure_patterns.name: Surrogate as decider rather than witness to values
pressure_patterns.safer_counterframe: The surrogate is asked to carry the person’s values, not win a family argument.

pressure_patterns.name: Donation heroism as consent pressure
pressure_patterns.safer_counterframe: Honor can be named without ranking deaths or coercing authorization.

pressure_patterns.name: Chosen dying collapses into suicide panic or eligibility advice
pressure_patterns.safer_counterframe: Separate natural dying, VSED, MAID, depression, distress, and legal processes; do not provide methods or eligibility guidance.
